amendments.normalized_body: `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:64` still runs only feed leaching, mineralization, and nitrification, and the only new chemistry change is the nitrification alkalinity debit at `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:366`. `crates/tank_core/src/types/substrate.rs:26` still has no suboxic-zone or denitrifier state to read from. As a result, this patch does not implement the bead’s core behavior: nitrate is never reduced to N2, the rate never depends on NO3/DOC/suboxic volume, and denitrification alkalinity is never returned.

The denitrification parameter surface and defaults are still missing. `crates/tank_core/src/types/process.rs:49` defines only the existing decomposer/nitrifier parameters plus a reserved constant, but there are no named fields for denitrifier activity, NO3 half-saturation, DOC half-saturation, or the pore-water diffusion/mixing factor. The default process pack also still stops at nitrification stoichiometry in `crates/tank_data/data/process/default.toml:52`.

Explicit N2 export accounting is not wired. The only budget-model change is adding alkalinity to `BudgetDelta`/`BudgetTotals` in `crates/tank_core/src/types/budget.rs:67`, while the nitrogen budget guard in `crates/tank_core/src/engine.rs:845` and `crates/tank_core/src/engine.rs:899` still only exempts open-system action fluxes. If denitrification starts removing nitrate inside `system:nitrogen_cycle`, it will be treated as an unexplained nitrogen leak instead of an explicit export path. The added test coverage also does not check any of the bead’s denitrification cases; `crates/tank_core/tests/nitrification_alkalinity.rs:1` is entirely about nitrification/alkalinity.
